The clone already contains Square.par, so the replacement must be explicit.

chapters.expectedResult: The submitted parameter file was checked against the intended copy.

The submitted file was checked against the intended hmax = 1010 m copy.

chapters.why: Import saves the selected source files in this example; it does not launch the model.

chapters.screenText: Keep runme.m as the Run target.

chapters.expectedResult: The +10 m change at hmax tapers along y; it is not a uniform addition.

instructions: Keep runme.m as the Run target. It requests two MPI processes.
hmin stays 300 m. The +10 m change at hmax tapers along the y-dependent thickness profile.
chapters.note: The thickness addition is not uniform over the shelf.
chapters.why: Run target selects the entry script; other imported files can act as helpers.
